title: Greywater Cannery
intent: A shore-side processing hall connects cold stores, boiler plant and shipping dock. Workers housing sits along the forest edge, linked by a short service-yard loop.

links.construction: Reserve at least 4.8 m total stair run plus 1.5 m landings, 1.5 m clear width, 2.2 m headroom, matching deck/ceiling voids and guards. Split into flights inside connector footprint during refinement.

staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Processing hall has two service exits plus shipping access. Separate worker loop reaches bunkhouse and mess without crossing machines. Mezzanine is optional observation; all rites remain at ground level.
systems: Cold-room gradients, boiler heat, wet floors, refrigeration noise and forest wind remain real normal signals. Industrial machinery is ordinary map infrastructure, never free investigator gear.
campaign: Manager ledger and worker payroll continue beyond closure; dock log can connect to Drowned Wharf. A forest boundary implies wider wilderness without adding empty playable kilometres.
refine: Research cannery processing/boiler separation and shore construction before detailed meshes.
Refine machine islands around at least two clear hall lanes and a reachable cold-store manual release.
Cold-store doors must always have an interior escape; no powered lock may create a permanent hunt trap.
